discovery.match: Match each scientist to their discovery.
discovery.reverse: Which of these scientists is credited with {value}?

rows.label: Albert Einstein
rows.hook: gave the world its most famous equation, linking energy, mass and the speed of light

rows.label: Marie Curie
rows.hook: became the first person to win Nobel Prizes in two different sciences

rows.label: Charles Darwin
rows.hook: sailed aboard the Beagle and argued that species change over generations

rows.label: Louis Pasteur
rows.hook: has a milk-heating process named in his honour and developed an early rabies treatment

rows.label: Ernest Rutherford
rows.hook: is called the father of nuclear physics for probing the atom's core

rows.label: Dmitri Mendeleev
rows.hook: arranged the chemical elements into a chart and predicted ones nobody had found yet

rows.label: Joseph John Thomson
rows.hook: showed that cathode rays are streams of tiny negatively charged particles

rows.label: Ivan Pavlov
rows.hook: ran famous experiments in which dogs learned to expect food at a signal

rows.label: Edward Jenner
rows.description: English physician, scientist and pioneer of vaccination (1749–1823)
rows.hook: used cowpox to protect people from smallpox

rows.label: Georges Lemaître
rows.hook: was a priest-scientist who first argued that the universe is expanding

rows.label: Wilhelm Röntgen
rows.hook: won the first Nobel Prize in Physics for rays that photograph bones

rows.label: Alessandro Volta
rows.hook: invented a stack of metal discs that gave the first steady electric current

rows.label: William Herschel
rows.hook: spotted a new planet beyond Saturn with a telescope he built himself
